content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Data Entry Operator at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal (An Autonomous Body under Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India)
12th pass; typing speed of at least 35 words per minute in English; working knowledge of MS Word and MS Excel

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhopal and the Project
content_sections.text: AIIMS Bhopal is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, at Saket Nagar, Bhopal. The post is in the Department of Urology, under a DHR funded project titled "Optimizing prostate cancer screening in Indian men: A cost effective multi-layered tool (SARTHIp) combining PSA dynamics, TRUS features, and a parallel-arm RCT for clinical validation; screening and risk-based tool for high-risk Indian men". The Principal Investigator is Dr Kumar Madhavan, Associate Professor, Department of Urology, AIIMS Bhopal. The notice also names Dr Devashish Kaushal as Guide.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application by email to [email protected] . The notice does not print a subject line for the email. Use the prescribed application form, which is printed with the notice as "Application Form - Data Entry Operator", and attach self-attested copies of certificates. The notice says the email should reach the Principal Investigator's address by the last date, 25-11-2026, 5:00 PM. The application form has these parts: Personal details: name in block letters, father's or mother's name, date of birth or age on the last date, gender, category (UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS), address for correspondence, mobile and e-mail. Educational qualification: examination, board or university, year, percentage, subjects or remarks, and any computer course. Skills: English typing speed in wpm, MS Word / Excel, REDCap or other data-entry software, and languages known. Experience: organisation, designation, period and nature of work. References: name, designation or organisation, and contact. Declaration with date and signature of the applicant.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: 12th pass. Typing speed of at least 35 words per minute in English. Working knowledge of MS Word and MS Excel. Up to 35 years on the last date of application, with relaxation as per Government of India rules. The notice does not list the relaxation by category. The engagement is initially for 1 year and is extendable to the end of Year 4, subject to performance and continuation of the project. The place of work is the Department of Urology, AIIMS Bhopal. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Data Entry Operator Job Description
content_sections.text: Entry and cross-checking of study data into REDCap. Data cleaning and resolution of data queries. Maintaining follow-up schedules and study files. Strict confidentiality of participant data.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational certificates and date-of-birth proof. Experience certificates (if any). Computer course certificate. Recent passport-size photograph. On the day of selection, candidates must bring original documents and one set of self-attested copies.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says selection will be by a Skill test / Written test / Interview. The date of selection is 26-11-2026, described as "test and interview". The notice does not print the venue or reporting time for the selection. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project; no claim for regularisation or absorption in AIIMS Bhopal will arise. Either side may terminate the engagement with one month's notice. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The institute reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment at any stage. The declaration in the form states that any false information will lead to cancellation of candidature.

faq.question: Q1. How many Data Entry Operator posts are there at AIIMS Bhopal?
faq.answer: There is one post, 01 (Unreserved), in the Department of Urology, under a DHR funded project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 25 November 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the AIIMS Bhopal Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to be 12th pass, with typing speed of at least 35 words per minute in English and working knowledge of MS Word and MS Excel.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 35 years on the last date of application, with relaxation as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 29,200/- per month consolidated.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications on the prescribed form with self-attested copies of certificates should be e-mailed to [email protected] by the last date.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be by a Skill test / Written test / Interview. The date of selection is 26 November 2026 (test and interview).

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. It is initially for 1 year and extendable to the end of Year 4, subject to performance and continuation of the project. No claim for regularisation or absorption will arise.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for attending the selection?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection.

faq.question: Q10. What should I bring on the day of selection?
faq.answer: Bring original documents and one set of self-attested copies.
